issues.rationale: A genre is used as a selection criterion, but the broad descriptor definition and genre boundary do not explicitly settle whether the same genre-only expression also qualifies without another descriptive property.
Radio may mean broadcast content or the physical player; the shuffle command does not settle that referent.
The reference may identify a radio device or broadcast medium; no hardware-specific evidence resolves it.

The utterance stops after the destination preposition. It indicates an incomplete argument, not an identifying destination reference; reference completeness and semantic absence cannot be resolved from this fragment.
A generic ticket alone is insufficient; the unfinished to may begin routing qualification but expresses no completed route. Retain uncertainty rather than invent a qualifier.
Ready could denote journey/service readiness or a physical preparation/repair state. The utterance supplies no purpose that settles the transport-service property boundary.
The room locates a controlled device, but the current domestic-surface rule resolves cleaning targets and destinations without settling whether this control-location role is a venue.
A human actor is expressed, but a standalone report supplies no explicit requested operation or message-payload instruction; relevance under current request scope remains unsettled.
A past visit is expressed, but standalone reporting versus request-relevant event content is not settled by the current scope rule.
A venue is expressed as the destination of the reported visit, but there is no explicit request establishing task relevance.

policy: Retain unavailable; batch triage distinguishes shared definition boundaries from input ambiguity. No automatic ontology edits or semantic admission.
